root_cause: The canonical PH-Pxxx Problem Library existed in production, but the executive cockpit still projected generic risks, actions and forecasts without a first-class canonical problem object, evidence explanation, explicit impact certainty label, capability mapping and outcome metric. That allowed the portal experience to drift from Problem Radar and commercial intelligence even while the backend taxonomy was canonical.
prevention_rule: Every executive problem surface must project a canonical PH-Pxxx identifier from the shared Problem Library, show evidence health/confidence, use only OBSERVED/ESTIMATED/POTENTIAL impact labels, map to an action/capability/outcome, expose why Powerhouse says it, reject local problem identifiers, and cap the executive start view at five priorities.

invariants: only PH-Pxxx problem ids reach the executive problem projection
unknown impact certainty fails safe to POTENTIAL
action capability and outcome remain visible on the same problem card
